Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Губы' is the genitive after 'у этой', marking whose shape it is. 'Форма' is the nominative subject. A descriptive pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative plural direction. 'К губам' uses the dative plural 'губам' after 'к' to show movement toward the lips. 'Чашку' is the accusative object. A common gesture.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural of negation. 'Губ' is the genitive plural after the negated imperative 'не закусывай'. Note the zero ending typical of feminine plurals. A caring warning.
